nameMismatch: The name does not match: type it exactly, with its accents.
loadFailed: Could not load the details. Close the dialog and try again.
failed: Could not delete. Try again later.
restoreFailed: Could not restore. Try again later.
daysLeft: {days, plural, one {# day left to restore} other {# days left to restore}}

property.zoneText: Remove the property from the workspace. It is kept for 30 days so you can restore it, then deleted for good.
property.title: Delete {name}?
property.hidden: The property, its website and booking pages disappear at once for everyone in the workspace and for guests.
property.restore: For {days} days you can restore it as it was from “Recently deleted” on the workspace home. After that the property and all its bookings, payments and invoices are deleted for good.
property.bookingsRule: It cannot be deleted while guests are staying or have upcoming bookings: cancel or move those bookings first.
property.booked: {count, plural, one {# booking} other {# bookings}} for guests staying now or arriving later. Cancel or move them before deleting.
property.invoices: {count, plural, =0 {Issued e-invoices stay} one {The # issued e-invoice stays} other {The # issued e-invoices stay}} with Mắt Bão and the tax portal. Download the ones you need before the 30 days are up.
property.deletedHint: You can restore it within 30 days from “Recently deleted” below.
property.recentLead: Deleted properties are kept for 30 days. Restore one to use it again as it was, website included.

workspace.zoneText: Delete the workspace and all its properties. It is kept for 30 days so you can restore it, then deleted for good.
workspace.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can delete the workspace.
workspace.title: Delete {name}?
workspace.hidden: {properties, plural, =0 {The workspace disappears at once} one {The workspace, its # property and its website disappear at once} other {The workspace, its # properties and their websites disappear at once}}{members, plural, =0 {.} one {; # member loses access.} other {; # members lose access.}}
workspace.restore: For {days} days you can restore it as it was from “Recently deleted” on the Workspaces page. After that all its properties, bookings, payments and invoices are deleted for good.
workspace.bookingsRule: It cannot be deleted while guests are staying or have upcoming bookings at any property: cancel or move those bookings first.
workspace.booked: {count, plural, one {# booking} other {# bookings}} for guests staying now or arriving later at its properties. Cancel or move them before deleting.
workspace.planPaid: The {plan} plan has {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left. The remaining time is lost and not refunded. If you restore the workspace within 30 days, the plan carries on as before: its end date ({date}) does not change.
workspace.planPaymentOpen: A plan payment is not finished yet. Wait until it is paid or expires, then delete.
workspace.invoices: Issued e-invoices of its properties stay with Mắt Bão and the tax portal. Download the ones you need before the 30 days are up.
workspace.deletedHint: You can restore it within 30 days from “Recently deleted” on this page.
workspace.recentLead: Deleted workspaces are kept for 30 days and only you, the owner, see them. Restore one to use it again as it was.
